assets.generation_prompt: Create one project art asset, class-wave, for a Grade 2 educational video call simulation. Use case: illustration-story. Warm bright picture-book gouache and colored-pencil illustration. Clean confident shapes, gentle dimensional shading, rich tactile texture. Soft daylight from upper left, soft blue classroom wall and pale wood furniture matching a painted kitchen gadget world. Three young children waving toward the video-call camera in a bright classroom. Natural range of skin tones and hair textures, friendly everyday clothes, one child with glasses. Clear warm faces and simple anatomically coherent open waving hands, waist-up group, centered with comfortable space around them. 4:3 landscape composition; will be shown in a small video-call inset so make faces and hand silhouettes clear. No text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos or watermark.
assets.edit_prompt: Edit this classroom video-call illustration. Keep exactly the three friendly children, their faces, hairstyles, clothes, waving hands, pose, colored-pencil and gouache style, lighting and composition. Replace only the background with a bright Grade 2 classroom: pale blue wall, a low shelf of plain colorful books with blank spines, a few small classroom chairs and a pale wood student table. The present background depicts a kitchen; remove every kitchen appliance, cooking pot, kettle, mixer, toaster, blender, and cooking utensil. This must visibly be a classroom. No lettering, logos, numbers or symbols anywhere.
